camera.motion: static (uniform grey floor, no texture; no shift detectable; both objects only)
camera.view: top-down (orthographic-looking) view onto the ground plane; image x/y = ground-plane axes
camera.note: frame 0 and frame 1 are identical (rendered duplicate); motion starts between frames 1 and 2

objects.name: cyclist
objects.description: person in black clothing riding a light-blue/cyan bicycle, seen from above, heading -x (left)
objects.leaves_frame: front reaches x=0 at frame 17; gone after frame 24
objects.reference_point: root_x/root_y = bicycle bbox centre (rear edge minus half length when clipped)

pixel_size_full_frames.note: length = front wheel tip to rear rack/wheel tip; width is handlebar span incl. rider hands. Height not visible (top-down).

objects.name: walker
objects.description: person in pale lavender/white shirt, dark trousers, dark hair, walking +x (right) above the cyclist path
objects.reference_point: pelvis_x/pelvis_y = centre of shirt (torso) bbox; head_cx/head_cy also given

pixel_size.note: top-down: standing height is NOT measurable in pixels; bbox_w oscillates with stride (feet apart max ~220 px)

objects.name: ground
objects.description: uniform grey floor, no markings, no static props

events.note: frames 0,1 identical; first displacement at frame 2

events.event: cyclist front reaches left image edge
cyclist and walker pass each other in x (root_x == pelvis_x)
events.frame: between 0 and 1 (cyclist starts at x~928, walker at x~947)
events.note: they are on separate parallel lanes ~200 px apart in y; no contact
